services.name: Lim's Taekwondo
services.desc: Every 4 months Grandmaster Lim has promotion tests for his students. It is a time for all of his students to show off their hard earned skills in front of their friends, family, and peers. Beginning in December of 2017, Grandmaster Lim decided to also share the testing experience with anyone who wanted to take a peek.

services.name: Introducing: Yoga by Lana
services.desc: My name is Lana Finley, and I'm very excited to announce the launch of my Yoga Vinyasa classes for all experience levels. They will be taking place at Lim’s Taekwondo every Saturday at 9am. Although I work for a tech company, I started practicing yoga 2011 and since then, I've been passionate about yoga, meditation, and relaxation. In 2020 I pursued a more professional approach to yoga and became a teacher! I’m excited to share with you my method for practicing and enjoying yoga. I want to help others to feel more at ease in the postures so that you can feel the benefits, have longevity in the practice, and are inspired to share yoga with your friends and loved ones.
